desc: Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

title: Kantara
desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

title: Khaidi No. 150
desc: Seenu, a criminal, escapes from the prison and places his doppelgänger, Shankar, in his place. However, upon learning about Shankar's noble mission, he takes up the cause himself.

title: Chandramukhi
desc: When a royal family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their mansion, they get in touch with a renowned psychiatrist to trace and tackle the possessed individual.

title: Extra Ordinary Man
desc: Abhinay, a struggling artist, meets the woman of his dreams and changes his aim. However, stumbling upon the chance to star in a movie, Abhinay's life takes a drastic turn.

title: Dhana 51
desc: A man befriends a girl who is the daughter of a police commissioner. He becomes an undercover cop and gives the commissioner leads about gangsters but is shocked when he is arrested and booked.

title: Solo
desc: Gautam, an orphan, wishes to marry a woman from a joint family and his dream comes true when he falls in love with Vaishnavi. However, Vaishnavi's father is against their marriage.

title: Gautamiputra Satakarni
desc: Gautamiputra Satakarni, who is the emperor of the kingdom of Satavahana, faces several threats and tries to overcome them during his attempts to unite all the kingdoms.

title: Yamudiki Mogudu
desc: Kaali, a ruffian, is killed by a rival when he falls in love with his daughter. When Kaali fights with the god of death, he is sent back in the body of a soft-spoken man.

title: Parugu
desc: A rich and powerful Neelakanta's perception about love marriage changes when both his daughters, Subbalakshmi and Meenakshi, fall in love.

title: Adhurs
desc: Twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up in vastly different environments. However, they are reunited when one gets kidnapped by gangsters.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.

title: The Warrior
desc: After enduring a ruthless gangster's cruelty, a former doctor transforms into a police officer and returns to his city on a quest for justice.
